name: 伟测科技
current_thesis: 伟测科技是A股稀缺的独立第三方IC测试龙头，2025-2026Q1受益于AI算力、智驾和高端芯片测试需求，收入和利润加速；但2026-07-09收盘价188.88元已显著反映乐观预期，且扩产带来折旧、负债和产能利用率风险，因此当前以观察仓和回撤买入为主。

position_plan.condition: 2026-07-09 price near 188.88 CNY and no new quarterly confirmation beyond 2026Q1
position_plan.reason: The business quality is strong, but current price already discounts optimistic high-end IC testing growth.

position_plan.condition: price falls into 130-145 CNY while revenue growth, gross margin and operating cash flow remain healthy
position_plan.reason: Risk-reward improves if fundamentals remain intact and valuation returns to the base-case fair value zone.

position_plan.condition: price falls into 115-125 CNY without deterioration in customer demand, utilization or equipment supply
position_plan.reason: This zone offers better margin of safety for a cyclical, capital-intensive semiconductor testing company.

position_plan.condition: price rises above 190 CNY without new evidence of stronger 2026-2027 earnings power
position_plan.action: do not add and consider reducing any tactical position
position_plan.reason: Upside becomes dependent on optimistic scenario assumptions.

price_triggers.reason: Enter the upper end of the preferred buy zone; review 2026 quarterly revenue, gross margin and operating cash flow before adding.
Potential high-conviction entry if high-end testing demand and utilization remain intact.
Price reaches reduce/watch zone; avoid chasing unless new order or margin evidence raises fair value.
Optimistic scenario largely priced in; reassess position size and valuation assumptions.

review_triggers.reason: Review 2026 interim report for growth durability, gross margin, depreciation burden and cash conversion.
Review 2026 third-quarter report and reassess 2026-2027 earnings assumptions.
